criteria.description: Every merged row appears exactly once in deterministic board-then-backlog order with exact per-scope positions.
Board, backlog, overlap, exclusive membership, and total counts reconcile exactly.
Status-to-column mappings preserve configured indices and explicit unmapped evidence.
The answer preserves complete board/backlog pagination and the exact bounded selection.
Hostile summary prose is treated only as untrusted data and no extra read or write is attempted.
